scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn elogix_api.main:app --reload --port 5000
scripts.openapi: cd apps/api && uv run python -m elogix_api.openapi > ../../openapi.json
scripts.generate: npm run openapi && npm run generate:client -w @elogix/web
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check && uv run pytest
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
